title: FF2MR12KM1P 62 mm C-Series CoolSiC Trench MOSFET half-bridge module (pre-applied TIM), datasheet V2.0, 2020-05-11, marked Preliminary Data
method: Table values copied from the datasheet text with a fetch tool (no curve digitized). Distributor-hosted (Farnell) copy of the Infineon PDF; cross-checked against the Mouser-hosted Japanese edition of the same V2.0 (https://mouser.com/datasheet/2/196/Infineon_FF2MR12KM1P_DataSheet_v02_00_JA-3162513.pdf): R_DS(on), E_on/E_off, R_thJH and r_i/tau_i match. This is a PRELIMINARY datasheet; a later final revision was not fetched (infineon.com product page/asset requests were blocked). Text extraction drops column labels: R_DS(on) '2,13 2,94 3,25' and V_SD '4,60 4,35 4,30 5,65' are mapped to Tvj 25/125/150 C by order (V_SD 5.65 V read as the 25 C max); no R_DS(on) max is printed. Only R_thJH (with Infineon pre-applied TIM) is given; R_thJC and R_thCH not stated. zth_foster is the Z_thJH (junction-to-heatsink) r_i/tau_i table printed with the MOSFET Z_th figure (sum r_i = 0.104 K/W = R_thJH); no separate body-diode table.

mosfet.I_D_note: I_D nom, DC, Tvj = 175 C, V_GS 15 V, T_H 60 C
mosfet.I_DM_note: I_D pulse (I_DRM), verified by design, t_p limited by Tvj max
mosfet.R_DSon_cond: V_GS 15 V, I_D 500 A (typ, mapped by order)
mosfet.E_cond: V_DS 600 V, I_D 500 A, V_GS -5/15 V, R_Gon 4.30 ohm, R_Goff 3.30 ohm, L_sigma 10 nH, di/dt 7.83 kA/us and du/dt 7.13 kV/us at Tvj 150 C (inductive)
mosfet.V_SD_cond: body diode, I_SD 500 A, V_GS -5 V
mosfet.R_thJH_note: per MOSFET, valid with IFX pre-applied thermal interface material

E_cond_num.note: E_cond 문자열의 시험 전압·전류를 숫자로 옮김(E37)
